joy.text: I just got the job I have wanted for ten years!

fear.text: Someone has been following me home every night this week.

grievance.text: My coworker took the credit for my project again and got promoted for it.

drudgery.text: I have rewritten this report nine times and my boss still says to redo it.

ease.text: It is a quiet Sunday, the tea is brewing and I have nowhere to be.
